## Verdict and scope

**Confirmed in the Excel presentation route; not present in the R scoring route.**
`results/tables/performance_table_avg.xlsx`, worksheet `performance_table_avg`, uses
`G2 = SQRT(Q2)`. Q2 contains the numeric value 0.005, not the original MSE;
the correct already-computed RMSE is also retained in AM2 as 0.074.
Thus the Excel route takes the square root of an MSE rounded to three decimals.
The identical pattern is checked across every populated RMSE row below.
There is no `sqrt(round(...))` in the current R source: the precision loss
occurs when formatted summary values become numeric spreadsheet inputs.
The workbook creation/import step is not scripted in this checkout, so its
specific copy/import operation cannot be attributed to a source-code line.

The manuscript `docs/NIH Manuscript for HSOR_V3.pdf` identifies A1 as
**noncore counties, reliability-restricted, without covariates** and A2 as
**core counties, reliability-restricted, without covariates**. Both report
**years 0 and 4**. A1 occupies PDF pages 42–44 (appendix pages 7–9);
A2 occupies PDF pages 44–47 (appendix pages 9–12). A2's caption says
“ncore,” a typographical error: all 36 numerical rows match the core-county
Excel results. Published RMSE values are extracted directly from the PDF
and checked against the Excel display below. Supplementary comparisons
cover both county groups, full and restricted samples, with and without
covariates, at all years 0–4.

The captions describe excluding the upper 10% within model and replication.
The current code instead pools median pre-fit RMSE across models and uses
scenario/county-group quantiles across replication rows. The recomputation
follows that code and reproduces its saved HTML values; this wording mismatch
is separate from the RMSE rounding defect. The main text also refers to
“Table A2” for training-intensity correlations, although that table is labelled
A3 in the appendix.

No models or assignment simulations are run. Existing files are read only.
CSV and extraction outputs are written to `checks/rmse_rounding/`.
Re-render from the repository with `quarto render checks/rmse_rounding/report.qmd`;
the project configuration places HTML under `_output/analysis/`. R packages required are
data.table, xml2, readxl and knitr. Large combined RDS inputs require substantial
memory; posterior columns are discarded immediately after loading.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(data.table)
library(xml2)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
find_repo_root <- function(start) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "data", "simulation", "sim_fits.rds")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "scoring.r"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) break
    candidate <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate repository from ", start,
       ". Expected data/simulation/sim_fits.rds and R/scoring.r in an ancestor directory.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
root <- find_repo_root(getwd())
out_dir <- file.path(root, "_output", "checks", "rmse_rounding")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
table_file <- function(filename) {
  candidates <- file.path(root, c("results/tables", "_output/legacy/output"), filename)
  available <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(available)) stop("Missing saved table: ", filename, call. = FALSE)
  available[[1L]]
}
write_csv <- function(x, name) fwrite(x, file.path(out_dir, name), na = "NA")
display <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
keys <- c("adjustment", "sample", "nc", "dgp", "model", "s")
```

## Exact source locations and all formatting routes

Chunks in the source R Markdown files are unnamed. The headings and line
numbers printed here identify them. `score()` creates squared errors without
rounding; `summ_score()` averages them and then takes their square root.
`fmt_number(decimals=3)` acts on the resulting gt display, including the
MSE column that was subsequently used by Excel. The precision-safe route is
to retain the numeric summary and display `se_diff`, not take `SQRT` of a
formatted `sq_diff`.

```{r}
#| label: source-locations
locations <- list(
  "R/scoring.r" = c(147:159, 203:244, 255:281, 291:338, 405:425),
  "analysis/3.0 prepare placebo results.rmd" = c(20:48, 55:65, 73:88),
  "analysis/3.2 summary placebo.rmd" = c(20:40, 58:91, 96:122, 271:285),
  "analysis/with_covariates/3c.0 prepare placebo results.rmd" = c(55:65, 73:87),
  "analysis/with_covariates/3c.2 summary placebo.rmd" = c(20:40, 58:91, 96:122),
  "analysis/3.3 other analysis.rmd" = c(95:102, 356:375),
  "analysis/3.1 check pre-fit reliability.rmd" = c(47:61),
  "archive/3. summary placebo.rmd" = c(216:235)
)
for (f in names(locations)) {
  if (!file.exists(file.path(root, f))) {
    cat("\nHistorical source unavailable in this checkout:", f, "\n")
    next
  }
  lines <- readLines(file.path(root, f), warn = FALSE)
  idx <- locations[[f]]; idx <- idx[idx <= length(lines)]
  cat("\n", f, "\n", paste(sprintf("%4d | %s", idx, lines[idx]), collapse="\n"), "\n")
}
source_files <- unlist(lapply(file.path(root,c("R","analysis","_archive")),
  function(folder) list.files(folder, pattern="\\.(r|R|rmd|Rmd|qmd)$",
                             recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)))
source_files <- source_files[!grepl("/checks/|/report\\.qmd$", source_files)]
audit <- rbindlist(lapply(source_files, function(f) {
  z <- readLines(f, warn=FALSE)
  i <- grep("round\\(|signif\\(|format\\(|sprintf\\(|fmt_number|pretty_fit|saveRDS|readRDS|write\\.|rank\\(|frank\\(", z)
  data.table(file=substring(f,nchar(root)+2), line=i, code=z[i])
}))
write_csv(audit, "formatting_and_io_audit.csv")
knitr::kable(audit)
```

`pretty_fit()` rounds its melted values (default three decimals) after
`summ_score()` has already produced RMSE; it is not called by the current
table-building chunks. `signif()` and base `format()` do not occur on these
routes. `sprintf()` in `fmedian_iqr()` formats already-computed medians/IQRs
in older/other-analysis tables. Pre-fit percentile rounding labels bins,
not outcome errors; pre-fit RMSE itself is unrounded. `round()` in XGBoost
only formats elapsed runtime. The covariate preprocessing script saves
the unrounded prediction rows at line 87. The no-covariate preprocessing
file ends after row filtering and has no save statement, although its
combined saved RDS is present under `data/simulation/`. No source reads back
rounded performance summaries for scoring. The Excel worksheet is the
identified downstream rounded-summary route.

## Inspect Excel formulas directly

```{r}
#| label: excel-formulas
xlsx <- table_file("performance_table_avg.xlsx")
unzip_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "xlsx_xml")
dir.create(unzip_dir, showWarnings=FALSE)
unzip(xlsx, files=c("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml", "xl/styles.xml"), exdir=unzip_dir)

cells <- xml_find_all(sheet,"//s:c",ns)
excel_cells <- data.table(cell=xml_attr(cells,"r"),
  formula=xml_text(xml_find_first(cells,"s:f",ns)),
  cached_value=xml_text(xml_find_first(cells,"s:v",ns)),
  style=xml_attr(cells,"s"))
write_csv(excel_cells,"excel_cells.csv")
book <- as.data.table(read_excel(xlsx))
book[, excel_row := .I + 1L]
book[, `:=`(adjustment="No covariates", sample="Restricted")]
book[, matches_sqrt_rounded_mse := abs(RMSE-sqrt(sq_diff)) < 1e-12]
stopifnot(all(book$matches_sqrt_rounded_mse))
knitr::kable(book[, .(excel_row,nc,dgp,model,s,RMSE,sq_diff,se_diff,
```

## Verify the actual manuscript tables

```{r}
#| label: manuscript-values
pdf_file <- file.path(root,"docs","NIH Manuscript for HSOR_V3.pdf")
pdftotext <- Sys.which("pdftotext")
if (!nzchar(pdftotext)) pdftotext <- file.path(path.expand("~"),
  ".cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/native/poppler/poppler/bin/pdftotext")
stopifnot(file.exists(pdftotext),file.exists(pdf_file))
pdf_text <- file.path(out_dir,"manuscript.txt")
status <- system2(pdftotext,c("-layout",shQuote(pdf_file),shQuote(pdf_text)))
stopifnot(status==0L)
pages <- strsplit(paste(readLines(pdf_text,warn=FALSE),collapse="\n"),"\f",fixed=FALSE)[[1]]
lines <- strsplit(paste(pages[42:47],collapse="\n"),"\n")[[1]]
county_group <- "NonCore"; scenario <- NA_character_; manuscript_rows <- list()
pattern <- "^\\s*(TWFE|ETWFE|RW-IID|RW-ST|GB-Ens|RW)\\s+(0|4)\\s+\\([0-9.]+\\)\\s*\\([0-9.]+\\)\\s+([0-9.]+)\\s+([0-9.]+)\\s+([0-9.]+)\\s+([0-9.]+)"
for (line in lines) {
  if (grepl("^Table A 1",trimws(line))) {county_group <- "Core"; scenario <- NA_character_}
  if (trimws(line) %in% c("MAR","Latent level","Latent trend")) scenario <- trimws(line)
  match <- regmatches(line,regexec(pattern,line,perl=TRUE))[[1]]
  if (length(match)>0L) manuscript_rows[[length(manuscript_rows)+1L]] <- data.table(
    appendix=ifelse(county_group=="NonCore","A1","A2"),nc=county_group,dgp=scenario,
    model=match[2],s=as.numeric(match[3]),pdf_rmse=as.numeric(match[4]),
    pdf_crps=as.numeric(match[5]),pdf_coverage=as.numeric(match[6]),
    pdf_interval_score=as.numeric(match[7]),sample="Restricted",adjustment="No covariates")
}
manuscript <- rbindlist(manuscript_rows)
stopifnot(nrow(manuscript)==72L,!anyNA(manuscript$dgp))
pdf_check <- merge(manuscript,book,by=keys)
stopifnot(nrow(pdf_check)==72L,all(display(pdf_check$pdf_rmse)==display(pdf_check$RMSE)),
          all(pdf_check$pdf_coverage==pdf_check$Coverage))
write_csv(manuscript,"manuscript_published_values.csv")
knitr::kable(manuscript,digits=3)
```

## Recompute from saved replication rows

The estimand follows the current source: cumulative counts within each
county/model/replication in **saved row order**, then county means within each
sample/scenario/model/year/replication. RMSE is the square root of the mean
squared discrepancy of those replication-level county means. It is not
the mean of county RMSEs. Bias retains the source convention `y - y0_hat`.
The reliability rule uses the median pre-fit RMSE across model/year rows
within scenario/replication/county, then excludes rows at or above the
scenario/county-group 90th percentile, as in the original code.

```{r}
#| label: recompute
recompute <- function(filename, adjustment) {
  cat("Reading",filename,"\n")
  saved <- readRDS(file.path(root,"data", "simulation",filename))
  cols <- c("dgp","nc","model","r","i","s","y","y0_hat","rmse_pre")
  x <- as.data.table(saved)[, ..cols]
  rm(saved); gc()
  stopifnot(all(x$s %in% 0:4), !anyNA(x$y0_hat))
  ordering <- x[, .(ordered=all(diff(s)>=0)), by=.(dgp,nc,model,r,i)]
  stopifnot(all(ordering$ordered))
  x[, c("y","y0_hat") := lapply(.SD,cumsum),
    by=.(dgp,nc,model,r,i), .SDcols=c("y","y0_hat")]
  x[, rmse_pre_agg := median(rmse_pre), by=.(dgp,r,i)]
  x[, keep := rmse_pre_agg < quantile(rmse_pre_agg,.9,na.rm=TRUE), by=.(dgp,nc)]
  group <- c("nc","dgp","model","s","r")
  aggregate_sample <- function(z, label) {
    ans <- z[, .(y=mean(y), y0_hat=mean(y0_hat), counties=.N), by=group]
    ans[, `:=`(sample=label, adjustment=adjustment)]
    ans
  }
  result <- rbind(aggregate_sample(x[keep==TRUE],"Restricted"),
                  aggregate_sample(x,"Full"))
  result[, `:=`(bias=y-y0_hat, squared_error=(y-y0_hat)^2)]
  result
}
replications <- rbind(recompute("sim_fits.rds","No covariates"),
                      recompute("sim_fits_wcov.rds","With covariates"))
summary <- replications[, .(R=.N, mse=mean(squared_error),
  rmse=sqrt(mean(squared_error)), bias=mean(bias), mae=mean(abs(bias))), by=keys]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(replications[, c(keys,"r"), with=FALSE]),
          all(summary$R==200L), nrow(summary)==720L)
write_csv(replications,"replication_level_recomputed.csv")
write_csv(summary,"unrounded_metrics.csv")
```

## Compare every available published cell

Difference below means recomputed minus published, after three-decimal
display. The CSV also retains both full precision RMSE values and their
unrounded difference. `CHANGED` flags every differing displayed value.

```{r}
#| label: compare
excel_pub <- book[, c(keys,"sq_diff","se_diff","excel_row"), with=FALSE]
excel_pub <- merge(excel_pub,manuscript[,c(keys,"pdf_rmse","appendix"),with=FALSE],by=keys)
setnames(excel_pub,"pdf_rmse","published_raw")
comparison <- merge(summary,excel_pub,by=keys,all.x=TRUE)
comparison[, `:=`(published=ifelse(is.na(published_raw),"Not available",display(published_raw)),
                  recomputed=display(rmse), unrounded_difference=rmse-published_raw)]
comparison[, difference := round(rmse,3)-round(published_raw,3)]
comparison[, flag := fifelse(is.na(published_raw),"No Excel cell",
                             fifelse(published!=recomputed,"CHANGED","Same"))]
write_csv(comparison,"rmse_comparison.csv")
appendix_comparison <- comparison[!is.na(published_raw)]
write_csv(appendix_comparison,"appendix_a1_a2_comparison.csv")
knitr::kable(appendix_comparison[,c("appendix",keys,"published","recomputed","difference","flag"),with=FALSE],digits=3)
knitr::kable(comparison[, c(keys,"published","recomputed","difference","flag"),with=FALSE],digits=3)

read_gt <- function(filename, adjustment, sample) {
  doc <- read_html(table_file(filename))
  rows <- xml_find_all(doc,"//tbody/tr")
  ans <- rbindlist(lapply(rows,function(row) {
    td <- xml_find_all(row,"./td")
    as.list(setNames(xml_text(td),xml_attr(td,"headers")))
  }),fill=TRUE)
  numeric_cols <- setdiff(names(ans),c("nc","dgp","model"))
  ans[, (numeric_cols) := lapply(.SD,function(z) as.numeric(gsub("−","-",z))),
      .SDcols=numeric_cols]
  ans[, `:=`(adjustment=adjustment,sample=sample)]
  ans
}
html <- rbindlist(list(
  read_gt("performance_table_avg.html","No covariates","Restricted"),
  read_gt("performance_table_avg_full.html","No covariates","Full"),
  read_gt("performance_table_avg_wcov.html","With covariates","Restricted"),
  read_gt("performance_table_avg_full_wcov.html","With covariates","Full")),fill=TRUE)
html_comparison <- merge(summary,html[, c(keys,"se_diff","sq_diff","diff","cvg","intv"),with=FALSE],by=keys)
html_comparison[, `:=`(published=display(se_diff),recomputed=display(rmse),
                       difference=round(rmse,3)-se_diff)]
html_comparison[, flag := fifelse(published!=recomputed,"CHANGED","Same")]
write_csv(html_comparison,"html_rmse_comparison.csv")
knitr::kable(html_comparison[,c(keys,"published","recomputed","difference","flag"),with=FALSE],digits=3)
```

```{r}
#| label: changes-and-ties
knitr::kable(comparison[!is.na(published_raw),.N,by=.(nc,s,flag)])
ties <- comparison[s==0 & !is.na(published_raw),
 .(models=.N, published_distinct=uniqueN(published),
   recomputed_display_distinct=uniqueN(recomputed), unrounded_distinct=uniqueN(rmse)),
 by=.(adjustment,sample,nc,dgp)]
write_csv(ties,"year0_ties.csv")
knitr::kable(ties)
cat("Excel display changes:",comparison[flag=="CHANGED",.N],"of",
    comparison[!is.na(published_raw),.N],"available cells.\n")
cat("HTML display changes:",html_comparison[flag=="CHANGED",.N],"of",
    nrow(html_comparison),"cells.\n")
```

The all-model year-0 ties from the spreadsheet are diagnosed by the
distinct-value counts above. Residual three-decimal ties can remain even
when all underlying RMSEs differ; those are ordinary final-display rounding,
not evidence of equality in full precision.

## Other quantities and ranks

Bias, MAE, coverage, CRPS and interval score all pass through the three-decimal
gt export. Excel E/F/K/L use `TEXT(...,"0.000")` to assemble bias/error and SD
strings; H/I/J link directly to already-rounded CRPS/coverage/interval-score
cells. None takes a square root. No interval **width** column is reported in
these performance exports: `intv` is interval **score**, including penalties
for noncoverage. The source computes bounds at 0.025 and 0.975 in `score_avg()`;
`cvg()` uses inclusive endpoints. No model-ranking calculation is saved in
the publication route. Rankings derived from the faulty spreadsheet RMSE
inherit its induced ties. The audit below compares such ranks with ranks
from full precision RMSE, using minimum ranks for ties.

```{r}
#| label: rank-and-bias-audit
ranks <- comparison[!is.na(published_raw)]
ranks[, `:=`(published_rank=frank(published_raw,ties.method="min"),
             corrected_rank=frank(rmse,ties.method="min")),
      by=.(adjustment,sample,nc,dgp,s)]
write_csv(ranks,"rank_comparison.csv")
knitr::kable(ranks[,c(keys,"published_rank","corrected_rank"),with=FALSE])
knitr::kable(html_comparison[,.(cells=.N,
  bias_display_changes=sum(display(bias)!=display(diff)),
  mse_display_changes=sum(display(mse)!=display(sq_diff))),by=.(adjustment,sample,nc)])
```

## Year-4 RMSE reductions and worst-case regret

These tables use **noncore, restricted, no-covariate** results and full
precision RMSE. Reduction is `100 * (1 - RMSE_model / RMSE_reference)`;
negative means worse. Regret is the scenario RMSE divided by that scenario's
lowest model RMSE; worst case is the maximum across the three scenarios,
all at year 4.

```{r}
#| label: reductions-and-regret
year4 <- summary[adjustment=="No covariates" & sample=="Restricted" & nc=="NonCore" & s==4]
reductions <- merge(year4[model %in% c("RW-IID","RW-ST"),.(dgp,model,rmse)],
 year4[model %in% c("TWFE","ETWFE"),.(dgp,reference=model,reference_rmse=rmse)],
 by="dgp",allow.cartesian=TRUE)
reductions[, percent_reduction := 100*(1-rmse/reference_rmse)]
write_csv(reductions,"year4_rmse_reductions.csv")
knitr::kable(reductions,digits=6)
regret <- copy(year4)
regret[, best_rmse := min(rmse),by=dgp]
regret[, regret := rmse/best_rmse]
worst <- regret[,.(worst_case_regret=max(regret),
                   worst_scenario=as.character(dgp[which.max(regret)])),by=model]
write_csv(regret,"year4_scenario_regret.csv")
write_csv(worst,"year4_worst_case_regret.csv")
knitr::kable(regret[,.(dgp,model,rmse,best_rmse,regret)],digits=6)
knitr::kable(worst,digits=6)
```

## Year-4 coverage and Monte Carlo standard errors

**Coverage provenance limitation:** combined saved RDS files contain latent
mean draws, not the Poisson-noised predictive draws or replication-level
coverage indicators used by the table script. Reproducing those indicators
would require calling `rpois()` again. To honor the no-simulation rule, this
report does not do that. Instead it obtains R from the saved replication
rows and recovers the covered count from saved HTML coverage. At R=200,
possible proportions are spaced 0.005 apart, so three-decimal rounding
uniquely identifies the count. This recovers exact unrounded *aggregate*
coverage, but does not independently verify individual interval membership.
Bounds, interval widths and interval scores cannot be independently
recomputed for the original predictive intervals under that constraint.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-mcse
coverage <- html_comparison[s==4]
coverage[, covered := as.integer(round(cvg*R))]
coverage[, p := covered/R]
stopifnot(all(abs(coverage$p-round(coverage$cvg,3))<1e-12))
coverage[, mcse := sqrt(p*(1-p)/R)]
coverage <- coverage[, c(keys,"R","covered","p","mcse"),with=FALSE]
write_csv(coverage,"year4_coverage_mcse_all_samples.csv")
primary_coverage <- coverage[adjustment=="No covariates" & sample=="Restricted" & nc=="NonCore"]
write_csv(primary_coverage,"year4_coverage_mcse.csv")
knitr::kable(primary_coverage,digits=6)
knitr::kable(coverage,digits=6)
```

## Input provenance and reproducibility

```{r}
#| label: provenance
inputs <- c("data/simulation/sim_fits.rds","data/simulation/sim_fits_wcov.rds",
 "docs/NIH Manuscript for HSOR_V3.pdf",
 "results/tables/performance_table_avg.xlsx","results/tables/performance_table_avg.html",
 "results/tables/performance_table_avg_full.html","results/tables/performance_table_avg_wcov.html",
 "results/tables/performance_table_avg_full_wcov.html")
input_paths <- vapply(inputs, function(f) {
  if (startsWith(f, "results/")) table_file(basename(f)) else file.path(root, f)
}, character(1))
inputs <- substring(input_paths, nchar(root) + 2L)
info <- file.info(input_paths)
provenance <- data.table(file=inputs,bytes=info$size,mtime=as.character(info$mtime))
write_csv(provenance,"input_provenance.csv")
knitr::kable(provenance)
sessionInfo()
```
